title: Recessed Toilet Paper Holder 6.125-Inch Solid Brass Carolina Collection | Traditional Bathroom Hardware Allied Brass
description:
Refresh your bathroom with a recessed toilet paper holder that tucks neatly into the wall for a streamlined, built-in appearance. This Carolina Collection accessory brings a refined traditional look that complements traditional bathroom hardware, classic bath accessories, and heritage bathroom fixtures.

Highlights:
- Recessed toilet paper holder design saves space and looks clean on the wall
- Traditional styling with classic design elements for coordinated bathrooms
- Concealed screw mounting hardware helps make installation straightforward
- Designer finish supports corrosion-free and rust-free performance
- Includes the recessed holder and all installation hardware

Specs:
- Collection: Carolina (matching Carolina collection pieces available)
- Material: Brass
- Mounting: Recessed/in-wall
- Dimensions: 6.125 in (L) x 6.125 in (H) x 4 in (W); projection 4 in
- Weight: 2.4 lb
- Assembly required: No
- Finish choices: Available in 28 designer finishes
- Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty
